name: agent-sample
reason: golden fixture: the smallest spec that satisfies every coded invariant

intent.text: A fixture spec that exercises every section the validator inspects, so a regression in any invariant has something to fail against.

scope.text: One node in every section, with the shapes the schema requires.
Any resemblance to a real crew role; this fixture is structural only.

constraints.text: Stays warning-free so a test can assert on a clean run.

behaviours.text: Validating this file unmodified exits 0 with no warnings.
Mutating one field of this file raises the invariant that field belongs to, and no other.

edges.text: The schema file is missing or unreadable: the validator exits non-zero rather than reporting the spec valid.
A section is absent entirely: the schema's required list rejects the file before any invariant runs.

decisions.text: Fixtures are mutated in a temp directory rather than stored one-per-case, so a case is a diff and not a duplicate file.

verification.text: node test/run.mjs exits 0 with every case reported pass.

acceptance.text: Every coded invariant in validate-spec.mjs has at least one case that fails without it.
